say:1:1610703001:1.text: Move it! If we're late, the <style="highlight">Daily Special</style> at the <style="highlight">Enchanted Cup</style> will be gone!
say:1:1610703001:1.source_cn: 别磨蹭了，再晚一点就买不到<style=highlig...
say:1:1610703001:1.male: Move it! If we're late, the <style="highlight">Daily Special</style> at the <style="highlight">Enchanted Cup</style> will be gone!
say:1:1610703001:1.female: Move it! If we're late, the <style="highlight">Daily Special</style> at the <style="highlight">Enchanted Cup</style> will be gone!

say:2:1610703002:1.text: The Enchanted Cup... that's the place on Holt Street, right?
say:2:1610703002:1.source_cn: 魔力绽放……是商业街上的店铺？
say:2:1610703002:1.male: The Enchanted Cup... that's the place on Holt Street, right?
say:2:1610703002:1.female: The Enchanted Cup... that's the place on Holt Street, right?

say:3:1610703003:1.text: Yeah! You've gotta try it. Their drinks are unreal! Beyond anything you can imagine.
say:3:1610703003:1.source_cn: 对啊，你们一定要试试，他们家的饮品绝对好喝，绝对超乎想象！
say:3:1610703003:1.male: Yeah! You've gotta try it. Their drinks are unreal! Beyond anything you can imagine.
say:3:1610703003:1.female: Yeah! You've gotta try it. Their drinks are unreal! Beyond anything you can imagine.

say:4:1610703004:1.text: That popular, huh? Their business must be booming.
say:4:1610703004:1.source_cn: 居然这么出名？欸，这么说，他们家生意一定很火爆了。
say:4:1610703004:1.male: That popular, huh? Their business must be booming.
say:4:1610703004:1.female: That popular, huh? Their business must be booming.

say:5:1610703005:1.text: They're packed every day. Oh, you know Niall, don't you? The one who got sick during the selection exam—
say:5:1610703005:1.source_cn: 是啊，人特别多。对了，你应该知道尼尔吧？就是在选拔赛里...
say:5:1610703005:1.male: They're packed every day. Oh, you know Niall, don't you? The one who got sick during the selection exam—
say:5:1610703005:1.female: They're packed every day. Oh, you know Niall, don't you? The one who got sick during the selection exam—

say:6:1610703006:1.text: You know Niall? And you even know about his illness?
say:6:1610703006:1.source_cn: 你们认识尼尔？还知道他生了怪病？
say:6:1610703006:1.male: You know Niall? And you even know about his illness?
say:6:1610703006:1.female: You know Niall? And you even know about his illness?

say:7:1610703007:1.text: We're both in the Divination Club, so we're close. The school never made an announcement, but everyone's been talking about it.
say:7:1610703007:1.source_cn: 我和尼尔都是命运占卜社的成员，还算熟悉。他的事情虽然学...

say:8:1610703008:1.text: He used to practically live at the Enchanted Cup. I heard he'd even skip class just to line up for their specials.
say:8:1610703008:1.source_cn: 他之前是魔力绽放的常客，听说他为了喝特调，还会翘课去排队呢！

say:9:1610703009:1.text: Ah, enough chatting. We've gotta run, Lor! Maybe there are still a few specials left!
say:9:1610703009:1.source_cn: 啊……快点快点，不能再聊下去了。洛尔，我们现在赶去霍尔...
